notes:
Summary:
- Target: VS Code copilot-like extension with streaming incremental tokens and inline suggestions.
- Latency SLOs: interactive inline suggestions p50 <50ms, p95 <120ms. Currently p99 spikes during cold cache.
- Throughput: 200 concurrent developer sessions (mostly short lived), expect bursts during standups.
- Cost sensitivity: prototype wants to keep hosted per-token spend < $0.001/token average; GA economics TBD.
- Model policy: must pin model version per release channel (stable/beta), ability to rollback to quantized variant.
- Auth/limits: company requires SSO (SAML) + per-user rate limits and per-org quota; clear retry semantics and headers for client backoff.
- Data residency: US-only for now; legal wants explicit data-at-rest and ingress/egress logs.
- Security: need SOC2 report, KMS integration for key wrapping, and 12 month audit log retention.
- Deployment preference: Hosted for alpha due to integration speed; dedicated pools for GA to meet latency and residency needs.
- Technical asks from SE call:
  * Streaming: incremental tokens must arrive with <10ms jitter from Redwood runtime to extension host after kernel emission.
  * Batching: suggest dynamic batching window for editor actions; need config knobs exposed in Optimize.
  * KV caching: want prefix caching for repo-level context and fast resume when switching files.
  * Fallbacks: automatic downgrade to compact model when capacity constrained; policy must be configurable per org.
  * Observability: per-route token/latency breakdown and per-user cost attribution for billing.
- Quotes from stakeholders:
  * "We can't have token leakage between sessions — strict isolation required." (Head of Security)
  * "Inline suggestions must feel instantaneous or engineers will ignore them." (CTO)
- Requested deliverables:
  1) POC metrics doc (perf matrix, token cost estimate) - see drive:/Sales/Halcyon/poc-plan-v2.pdf
  2) Security pack (SOC2 + KMS integration notes) - drive link above
  3) Suggested batching/config presets for editor workloads (SE to deliver by 2026-03-17)
- Open items / next actions:
  • Redwood SE to run targeted microbench for streaming jitter and submit results by 2026-03-14.
  • Legal to review data residency clause and redline SOW (Halcyon legal to return comments).
  • Confirm rate limit schema and per-user quota enforcement; Halcyon needs a testing endpoint to simulate throttles.
